**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Virginia Conservation Police seized more than 1,300 illegally gathered ginseng roots in the Bluefield area after investigating trespassing reports, with charges pending for trespassing, buying without a permit, and unlawful possession.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/09/suspects-found-illegal-gathering-ginseng-cases/)[[2]](https://swvasun.com/illegal-ginseng-harvesting-suspected-in-tazewell-county-p18739-31.htm) Mercer County events include a senior expo Thursday in Princeton and a toy show at Mercer Mall; Bluefield State University announced new Board of Governors appointments.[[3]](https://www.tcpsva.org/news/)[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/more-than-2-000-have-already-voted-early-in-tazewell-county/article_a8d5d78b-a0da-454e-b272-7c21743d3b68.html) Tazewell County election results show high Republican support in local races with 47% turnout.[[5]](https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/tazewell-county/2026-November-General) No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core or immediate region.

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Virginia Conservation Police officers investigated reports of trespassers digging ginseng on private property in the Bluefield area. Surveillance led to suspects; more than 1,300 roots (including six underage) were seized. Violations include trespassing to dig ginseng, buying without a permit, and unlawful possession. No suspects publicly named yet; investigation ongoing as of Nov. 9.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/09/suspects-found-illegal-gathering-ginseng-cases/)[[2]](https://swvasun.com/illegal-ginseng-harvesting-suspected-in-tazewell-county-p18739-31.htm)

Bluefield, WV Police Department released a list of 30 individuals with outstanding municipal court bench/arrest warrants (offenses range from traffic to drugs/assault); individuals urged to contact the department.[[6]](https://www.lootpress.com/bluefield-police-department-releases-list-of-30-individuals-wanted-on-municipal-court-warrants/)

**Mercer County, WV / Region:** No new arrests or major cases reported in the last 24 hours. Earlier October indictments and warrant lists noted but not developing today.

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA police, or Mercer County Sheriff.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
NWS alerts: none active.

No flooding, winter weather, burn bans, power outages, boil-water notices, or VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on core routes (US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, I-77) or regional interstates.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Unofficial Nov. 3 general election results released Nov. 9 show 47% turnout (13,256 ballots cast). Joe R. Beasley re-elected Tazewell town mayor (96.36%). Town council seats filled by Renee Dawn Adair, Glen A. Keen Jr., and Carolyn S. “Carrie” Moore.[[5]](https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/tazewell-county/2026-November-General)

**Mercer County, WV:** New appointments announced to Bluefield State University Board of Governors.[[3]](https://www.tcpsva.org/news/)

**Region:** No new state actions from Richmond, Charleston, or elsewhere impacting the area reported today.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Mercer County, WV:** Mercer Mall to host Toy Show. Princeton Hammer & Stain hosting ceramics event. Annual senior expo Thursday in Princeton.[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/more-than-2-000-have-already-voted-early-in-tazewell-county/article_a8d5d78b-a0da-454e-b272-7c21743d3b68.html)

Renovated Big Four Lodge in McDowell County celebrating grand reopening Saturday.[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/07/mercer-county-veterans-breakfast-returns-organizer-hands-off-event/)

**Tazewell County, VA / Region:** Tazewell Today holiday events lineup includes Veterans Parade (Nov. 8, already held) and Bingo Nov. 15.[[8]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/) No plant/mine/hospital openings, closings, or layoffs reported.

- Saturday: Grand reopening of renovated Big Four Lodge, McDowell County, WV.[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/07/mercer-county-veterans-breakfast-returns-organizer-hands-off-event/)
